therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: AMPK activation leading to mTOR inhibition and metabolic modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of insulin/IGF-1 signaling and metabolic factors associated with breast cancer risk
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Women at risk for obesity-associated breast cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in breast density at 6 and 12 months

results.effect_size: Greater reduction in breast density with metformin vs placebo at 6 months (-13.71 vs -5.45 cm³) and 12 months (-14.75 vs -12.11 cm³)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Reduction in serum insulin levels (13.5 to 11.7 uIU/ml vs 14.6 to 13.1 uIU/ml placebo)
safety_signals: No serious adverse events clearly attributable to metformin
results.dose_information: 850 mg daily for 4 weeks, then 850 mg twice daily for remainder of 12-month treatment period
